messages:
ellie: Heads up — FinCo SRE asked for a dataflow diagram + CSV of subprocessors for the POC. POC kickoff Mon (4/14). They want: where request logs & tokens live, EU-only routing options, backups/retention, KMS locations. Need Visio/SVG + CSV. cc @anjali @mike @tara

anjali: Got it. Quick question — is this POC on Hosted API or are they planning Dedicated/Private from day 1? Security posture and subproc disclosure differ.

ellie: Hosted initially, but they want the option to move to Dedicated/Private after POC. Primary ask is EU residency for EU customer content + audit artifacts for vendor risk (SIG/CAIQ answers).

mike: I can sketch the diagram. For clarity: Hosted supports eu region endpoints; control plane and orchestration live in our control plane regions (usually us-west-2), inference pods can be in eu-west-1 for EU-only processing if we route there. Dedicated/Private gives guaranteed EU-only compute + optional customer-managed KMS. I will confirm exact regions for this account.

sam: For delivery, propose 2 artifacts: 1) minimal dataflow SVG (client -> Redwood EU API endpoint -> inference in eu-west (or fallback to us) -> KMS (redwood KMS or customer KMS) -> logs & metrics S3 in eu-west if pinned) and 2) subprocessor CSV. Keep diagram simple for non-technical auditors.

doc-bot: CAIQ export and current subproc CSV (redacted contacts) are available here: https://docs.redwood.internal/sig/exports/finco-placeholder (internal link)

mike: Example CSV format I'll drop here so Legal sees expected fields:

```
subprocessor, role, country, purpose, contract_link
AcmeCloud, hosting, Ireland, object storage for logs, https://vendor-contracts/acme
KeySafeCorp, kms, Germany, key management for Dedicated/private, https://vendor-contracts/keysafe
AnalyticsCo, monitoring, US, metrics and alerting, redacted
```

tara: We can share the subproc list; redact personal contact info. For enterprise deals we attach the DPA; if they request more detail we can do an NDAd + SOC2 report review. No blockers from Legal for the CSV as long as we redact vendor PII.

anjali: A couple of security clarifications to include on the diagram/text: backups — for Hosted, backups are stored in the region where data is processed with optional cross-region replication for DR (default: enabled for critical infra, can disable on request). For Dedicated/Private we can guarantee backups confined to the customer's region.

mike: Logs note: request metadata (non-content) retained 30 days by default. Content logs are not stored persistently for Hosted unless customer enables "retain transcripts". For POC, we should ask FinCo whether they want content logging on; default is no. Also note that telemetry/metrics are aggregated and sent to our monitoring pipeline (AnalyticsCo) — we can provide a low-level mapping in the CAIQ.

ellie: Plan: I'll draft the SVG diagram by Thu EOD and the CSV + CAIQ answers by Fri. @anjali @tara — can you both review before I send to FinCo? Also, they asked for a one-page plain-English statement about EU residency and cross-border flows — can someone take that?

anjali: I can draft the plain-English statement. Will mention Hosted eu endpoint availability, control plane location caveat, and options (Dedicated/Private) for strict EU residency.

tara: I'll review the CSV and confirm which vendor contact info must be redacted. Also confirm whether we can include the SOC2 link; usually we provide the report under NDA.

mike: I'll attach a quick PNG sketch in this thread when done. If FinCo needs a Visio, Sam/Design can export SVG->Visio after approval.

ellie: Awesome — thanks team. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a dry-run of the artifacts Thu 11am. :thumbsup:
